change.title: defer snapshot fingerprints until an explicit diagnostic demand

claim_boundary.timing_scope: measured_total_ns covers native DOC owner/public validation, in-memory owner rendering, and output materialization; deterministic replacement text is prepared before the lifecycle timer; same-lineage patch apply and first source/target FNV-1a fingerprint demand are timed after that boundary as workflow extensions
claim_boundary.performance_claim: attribution-only correctness and deferred-work accounting; measured_total_ns is the established lifecycle boundary, synchronous observer overhead is included, and no speedup, I/O, allocation, RSS, cold-start, or producer claim is made
claim_boundary.positive_faster_definition: 100 * (control - candidate) / control; positive means the candidate is faster; deferred_fingerprint remains a negative demand-cost delta when work is intentionally deferred
claim_boundary.accepted_claim: The retained primary vectors and guard vectors are reproducible correctness and attribution evidence for the named DOC/CFB in-memory corpus and the reported control/candidate builds.

source_and_environment.runtime_git_revision_note: Every raw report records the clean invoking worktree HEAD, which was the candidate revision for both control and candidate process legs. This field is not binary provenance; control/candidate binary identity is bound by binary_source_commits and the verified binary SHA-256 values in change.

phase_statistic_method.p50: integer midpoint of the two central sorted values
phase_statistic_method.pooled: concatenate the four same-shape process vectors before statistics
phase_statistic_method.phase_share: use chronologically aligned phase and measured_total vectors; compute phase/measured-lifecycle percentage per sample before statistics
phase_statistic_method.stability_review_trigger: report any same-implementation per-leg p50 or mean spread above 5 percent; do not pool different shapes

limits: Primary evidence retains 6,000 samples: four legs, three shapes, 500 samples per shape.
Guard evidence retains 24,000 samples: eight files, six cases, 500 samples per case.
The corpus is deterministic and generated in memory; no physical-I/O, cold-cache, or real-producer claim is made.
time/RSS values are descriptive whole-process /usr/bin/time -v observations, not operation-scoped measurements.
Heaptrack is a three-sample run with preflight included and is not operation-scoped; allocation, peak heap, and profiler RSS values are descriptive.
The retained vectors are the authority for statistics; rounded paired deltas are the final values from deltas.tsv and guard-deltas.tsv.
